title: Finding
description: Schema for an individual security check finding in Traceon.

finding_id.description: Unique identifier for this finding (e.g. f_001).

check.description: Identifier of the check that discovered this finding (e.g. pickle_opcode, safetensors_verify).

deterministic.description: True for opcode, hash, and structure checks. False for statistical and behavioural ones.

title.description: Concise human-readable title describing the finding.

evidence.description: Evidence supporting the finding (e.g. module, callable, offset, sha256).

recommendation.description: Actionable guidance to remediate the issue.
